House of Representatives
His Story

A Son of the Soil

Long before he ever asked for your vote — Prince Olisa Okwuchukwu Eze was already working for you. Born and raised in the heart of this constituency, he grew up understanding the real weight of our community's struggles.

"He knows what it means to watch a child drop out of school because fees were not paid. He knows the grief of a family turned away at the hospital gates."

He is not a politician who discovered the poor at election time. He is a son of this soil who has served without cameras, without applause, and without asking for anything in return. Through the Excellency Hope Initiative, Prince Olisa quietly and consistently invested in the people of Dunukofia, Njikoka and Anaocha.

Vision & Agenda

His Promise to Dunukofia

A five-pillar agenda rooted in the real needs of our people — backed by a proven track record of delivery.

🛣
Infrastructure & Roads
Rehabilitate roads and transport networks so goods, people, and opportunities move freely across our constituency.
💼
Youth Employment
Skills acquisition, vocational centres, and entrepreneurship funds that give our youth real tools to build futures here at home.
📚
Education
School infrastructure, federal bursaries, and quality education for every child — building on 200+ scholarships already delivered.
🏥
Healthcare
Stronger hospitals, equipped clinics, and maternal care services — quality healthcare close to home is a right, not a luxury.
📈
Investment & Development
Using his global network and business expertise to attract federal and private investment — making Dunukofia, Njikoka and Anaocha a destination for growth, not a departure point for our best people.
